input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit right binding us and it meets the preferred position on every material term: frequency capped at once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and express prohibition on direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information. Section 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of report, and finality of the audited quantity on payment). No remote-access or unannounced audit language appears elsewhere in the document. No redline required.
